build_RULEDOMAIN_bottom_up: build a RuleDomain and use bottom_up to apply a rewrite rule to all leaves then parents up to the root
create_PATTERNRULE: create a PatternRule that matches a pattern and applies a projection function to transform the matched value
compose_Compose: compose two rules sequentially so the second rule transforms the output of the first rule
build_FIRSTMATCH: build a FirstMatch rule that tries multiple rules in order and returns the first successful result
refactor_RULEDOMAIN_top_down: refactor a tree transformation using RuleDomain top_down to apply a rule from root to all children recursively
